fieldNotes.location: Confirmed. UNFI Joliet DC at 2601 Ellis Rd, Joliet, IL 60433 (street address geocoded ROOFTOP to 41.50567,-88.01851; Waze and TruckMap both name a 'UNFI - Truck Entrance' at 2601 Ellis Rd). The roster's city-level coords (41.5250,-88.0830) were ~8km off; corrected to the resolved Ellis Rd building. A modern logistics-park warehouse running N-S in the Joliet/CenterPoint-area industrial corridor; trade press notes UNFI is investing in full-case automation here. Absorbed Sturtevant WI volume per roster.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE - the truck driveway from Ellis Rd runs north into the property to a checkpoint. At z20 a clear guard-booth structure sits in the lane with a circular landscaped island, lane control and a concrete checkpoint apron; perimeter chain-link/metal fencing runs the property line (visible behind the Ellis Rd treeline in Street View).
fieldNotes.guardShack: TRUE - small staffed booth (~1-vehicle footprint, beside the lane on the landscaped island) at the truck entrance. remoteGs=false accordingly.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: TRUE - the gate sits well back from Ellis Rd behind a wide landscaped buffer; the gate-to-dock approach and internal yard easily hold a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: TRUE - large paved yard inside the gate before the dock faces, with marked trailer rows used as staging/holding.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: TRUE - wide gate apron with substantial unused paved width; room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ - long dock bank runs the east face of the warehouse with many trailers backed in; band 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ - extensive trailer drop/staging yard on the south and west sides, dozens of trailers parked without tractors (orange and blue trailers visible).
fieldNotes.dropYard: TRUE - dedicated trailer-storage lot separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - edge-of-Joliet logistics park surrounded by farmland and other big-box warehouses, not dense metro fabric.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~38 acres estimated from the perimeter box; honest estimate from overhead imagery.
